research_notes: SOURCE ACCESS: every document came straight from Bank Mega's own servers (bankmega.com/media/filer_public/... and cdn.bankmega.com/prod.mega.cms.media/...), linked from the IR page https://bankmega.com/id/tentang-kami/hubungan-investor-new/ on 2026-11-03; plain curl with a browser User-Agent, no bot challenge, no Internet Archive needed. idx.co.id was not used.

ENTITY / BASIS: Bank Mega has no subsidiaries in any year 2019-2025 (AR2025 PDF p. 112; AR2022 PDF p. 100; the audited statements are titled 'Laporan Keuangan', not 'konsolidasian'). Its own audited statements are therefore the whole reporting entity: money fields are stored with basis 'consolidated' (the validator requires it for profit/equity), ratios with 'bank_only' as printed in the OJK-format ratio tables. Equity attributable = total equity (no NCI). The parent PT Mega Corpora (58.02%) publishes separate consolidated statements - not used.

BONUS ISSUES (IMPORTANT FOR THE PAGE CODE): MEGA had two bonus issues in the window and NO split, reverse split or rights issue since 2006 (AR2025 PDF pp. 112-113 share-listing chronology; AR2025 p. 22: no corporate action in 2025). (1) ex 2022-03-10: 1,000 -> 1,686 shares (587 bonus from share premium + 99 stock dividend from retained earnings). (2) ex 2026-04-10: 1 -> 2 shares (1:1 bonus from share premium). Both are recorded as type 'bonus' per SCHEMA.md, so in v1 they do NOT drive the per-share adjustment factor. Consequences: (a) EPS/DPS/price history is discontinuous at both dates (FY2021 EPS 576 vs FY2022 345; FY2025 EPS 287 vs 9M2026 EPS 78 on 23.48bn shares); (b) the daily-price validator's '>35% one-session move' rule will fire on 2022-03-10 (theoretical -40.7%) and 2026-04-10 (about -50%) unless the bonus factor is applied; (c) Yahoo usually books bonus issues as split events, so stocks_prices.php may refuse MEGA ('Yahoo splits != corporate_actions.json'). The owner must decide whether to record these as split-type actions (factors 1.686 and 2) or extend the code to treat 'bonus' like a split; nothing was changed here.

PER-SHARE BASIS: every FY per-share value and share count is stored as printed in that year's own audited FS / AR with share_basis = the FY end date (the date on which the printed figure and the share count matched; eps x shares_out = profit within 0.2% every year). FY2020-FY2021 figures are on 6,963,775,206 shares (pre-2022-bonus), FY2022-FY2025 on 11,740,923,365 (pre-2026-bonus), the 9M2026 interim on 23,481,846,730. Restated values printed later (not stored): FY2021 EPS 341 (FS2022, AR2025), FY2020 EPS 256 and FY2019 171 (AR2023/AR2024), 9M2025 EPS 187 -> 94 (FS9M2026 comparative).

SHARE COUNT CONFLICT: the AR share-price tables print 'Jumlah Saham Beredar' of 6,894,138,227 (2020-2021) and 11,623,514,905 (2022-2025) and compute market cap on them, about 1.0% below the issued and fully paid count in the audited FS (6,963,775,206 / 11,740,923,365). The FS show no treasury shares, EPS uses the issued count, and the dividends and the 2026 bonus were distributed on 11,740,923,365 shares; the AR does not explain the lower figure (possibly shares not listed on IDX). shares_out uses the FS count.

DIVIDENDS: exactly one cash dividend out of each of FY2020-FY2025, the final after the AGMS; no interim or special dividends (each statement of changes in equity / cash-flow statement shows one payment a year: 2,100,000 / 2,800,000 / 2,836,818 / 2,457,420 / 1,052,400 / 2,018,820 Rp juta in 2021-2026). Dividend policy: at least 20% of net profit unless the AGMS decides otherwise (AR2025 PDF p. 171). FY2021 and FY2025 dividends share their recording date with a bonus issue, so both were paid on the pre-bonus share count. The 2022 bonus issue also contained a stock dividend (689,413,745 shares, Rp6,687,304 juta from retained earnings at Rp9,700) - not a cash dividend, recorded only in corporate_actions. Payout ratios as printed: 70 / 70 / 69.99 / 69.99 / 39.99 / 60 (FY2021: AR2023 prints 69.82%).
